risk_notes: All third-party dependencies (flask, fastapi, starlette, pytest) are imported but never pinned — no requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, or lockfile shown.
Optional-import pattern (try/except ImportError) masks which versions are actually expected at runtime, making supply-chain auditing harder.
TRUST_PROXY is read from environment and controls whether X-Forwarded-For is honored; misconfiguration is a deployment-time risk but not a dependency risk.

No container image, install script, curl|bash, or package-manager invocation appears in the output — supply-chain surface is implicit (whatever the host environment provides for flask/fastapi/pytest).
